title: Logs for the {place}
The saw stands idle
summary: The {place} in {settlement} waits on timber: {giver} needs {count} × {item}, whole and unsplit, for the saw.
There is no timber in the yard of {settlement} for its {place}. Bring {count} × {item}.
offer: We have the frame of the {place} drawn out on the ground and not a log to cut it from. {count} × {item}, if you can fell them — I pay above market.
The foresters are behind and the {place} will not wait. Could you bring {count} × {item}?
progress: Logs, friend. The saw wants feeding.
complete: Good straight timber. The {place} will have its beams by the week's end.
That fills the yard nicely. Thank you.
